title: March Madness Reportedly Generates $410M of In-Game Brand Exposure

facts.fact: Men's and women's March Madness delivered more than $410 million in media exposure value for featured brands in telecasts, according to a report by Elevate Sports Ventures and Hive.
facts.quote: Men’s and women’s March Madness delivered more than $410 million worth of media exposure value for featured brands in telecasts

facts.fact: Capital One led the women's tournament with 13 hours and 25 minutes of brand exposure.
facts.quote: Capital One led the women’s tournament with 13 hours and 25 minutes of exposure

facts.fact: AT&T led the men's tournament with nine hours and 13 minutes of brand exposure.
facts.quote: AT&T led the men’s with nine hours and 13 minutes.

facts.fact: Companies received about 187 total hours of exposure across all 134 men's and women's tournament games.
facts.quote: In all, companies received about 187 total hours of exposure during all 134 men’s and women’s games.

facts.fact: The women's March Madness championship game peaked at almost 6 million viewers.
facts.quote: with the championship game peaking at almost 6 million viewers

facts.fact: Women's March Madness viewership averaged 18% more than in 2021.
facts.quote: It averaged 18% more than 2021, and 30% more than 2019.

facts.fact: Women's March Madness viewership averaged 30% more than in 2019.
facts.quote: It averaged 18% more than 2021, and 30% more than 2019.

facts.fact: From the last day of the women's second round onward, both tournaments generated $245 million in media exposure.
facts.quote: From the last day of the women’s second round onward, both tournaments generated $245 million in exposure.

facts.fact: Elevate and Hive found that up to the start of the women's second-round cutoff point, $165 million in media exposure had been generated.
facts.quote: Elevate and Hive found that up to that point, $165 million had been generated.
